controles.affirmation: fondamental_externe #2 (judiciaire) : CAT annule par la 11e Cour d'appel en juillet 2025 ; nouveau modele approuve par la SEC le 16 mars 2026 ; nouveau recours de Citadel Securities et de l'American Securities Association ; sursis rejete le 14 juillet 2026
controles.verbatim_source: "The 11th Circuit vacated the CAT Funding Model order in July 2025." ; "On March 16, 2026, the SEC issued an order approving an amendment to the National Market System Plan Governing the CAT... Regarding Implementation of a Revised CAT Funding Model" ; "Citadel Securities, LLC and the American Securities Association filed a petition for review of the Revised CAT Funding Model in the 11th Circuit." ; "On April 2, 2026, ASA and Citadel filed a motion to stay the 2026 CAT Funding Model Order, which the 11th Circuit denied on July 14, 2026." (note 21)

controles.affirmation: fondamental_externe #2 : "la decision sur le fond reste attendue apres la cloture des plaidoiries le 23 juillet 2026"
controles.verbatim_source: "Expedited briefing on the merits ended on July 23, 2026."
controles.correction_proposee: "Briefing" designe l'echange de memoires ecrits, pas des plaidoiries orales. Le 10-Q ne mentionne aucune audience. Ecrire : "l'echange accelere de memoires sur le fond s'est acheve le 23 juillet 2026". Le mot "plaidoiries" laisse croire a une audience tenue qui n'est nulle part attestee.

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #1 : "Au 30 juin 2026, la Bourse crypto Cboe Digital Exchange ne compte plus aucun produit cote"
controles.verbatim_source: "There are no products currently listed for trading on the Cboe Digital Exchange."

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #1 + ce_qui_affaiblirait #3 : "l'infrastructure Cboe Digital acquise specifiquement pour le crypto tourne aujourd'hui a vide" ; l'ATT presente comme un evenement futur hypothetique "sa fermeture formelle actant la fin du pivot crypto"
controles.verbatim_source: "On May 1, 2026, the Company announced additional actions related to its strategic realignment, which has been ongoing since 2025 and is expected to be substantially completed by the end of 2026. In connection with the various programs and actions, including, but not limited to, the wind downs of Cboe Digital, Cboe Japan, and CEDX..." (note 3)
controles.correction_proposee: Omission materielle : la fermeture de Cboe Digital n'est pas une hypothese future, elle est deja annoncee. Le 10-Q liste explicitement Cboe Digital parmi les activites en cours de liquidation ("wind downs"), operation annoncee le 1er mai 2026 et attendue pour l'essentiel d'ici fin 2026. Reecrire : "Cboe Digital n'a plus aucun produit cote et sa liquidation a ete annoncee le 1er mai 2026", et retirer de ce_qui_affaiblirait la mention d'une fermeture formelle a venir, qui est deja actee.

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #1 : "cette plateforme dediee avait ete financee en partie par l'emission de 300 M$ de Senior Notes en mars 2022"
controles.verbatim_source: "On March 16, 2022, the Company issued $300 million aggregate principal amount of 3.000% Senior Notes due 2032... The Company used the net proceeds from the 3.000% Senior Notes, together with cash on hand, and the proceeds of additional borrowings, to partially fund its acquisition of Cboe Digital."

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #1 : "les futures Bitcoin et Ether cash-settled ont ete transferes vers CFE, qui a lance leur negociation en continu en decembre 2025"
controles.verbatim_source: "On June 9, 2025, Cboe successfully completed the migration of cash-settled Bitcoin and Ether futures contracts from Cboe Digital Exchange to CFE. CFE also subsequently launched continuous Bitcoin and Ether futures contracts on December 15, 2025."

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #2 (reglementaire) : fermeture de Cboe Japan et BIDS Japan le 23 mars 2026 apres suspension en aout 2025 ; Cboe Australia et Cboe Canada classes en actifs detenus en vue de la vente au 30 juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: "The Company suspended operations for these businesses on August 29, 2025, and formally closed these businesses following regulatory approval on March 23, 2026 to discontinue its Financial Instruments Business registration." (note 8) ; "In April 2026, management concluded that the Company's Cboe Australia and Cboe Canada businesses met the accounting requirements to be classified as held for sale, but did not meet the criteria for discontinued operations." ; bilan : "Assets held for sale 261.0" / "Liabilities held for sale 31.7" (note 3)

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #2, reference de source : "(10-Q T2 2026, note 5)"
controles.verbatim_source: La note 5 du 10-Q T2 2026 est "5. PROPERTY AND EQUIPMENT, NET". La cession Cboe Australia / Cboe Canada figure en note 3 ("ACQUISITIONS AND STRATEGIC REALIGNMENT") et en note 23 ("SUBSEQUENT EVENTS") ; la fermeture de Cboe Japan figure en note 8 ("GOODWILL, INTANGIBLE ASSETS, NET, AND DIGITAL ASSETS HELD").
controles.correction_proposee: Renvoi de note errone. Remplacer "note 5" par "notes 3 et 8".

controles.affirmation: fondamental_externe #1 : "Cboe indique explicitement que ses volumes sur ses produits proprietaires VIX et SPX dependent de licences exclusives qui doivent etre renouvelees"
controles.verbatim_source: "trading volumes on our proprietary products such as VIX options and futures and SPX options, which are dependent on exclusive licenses that require renewals"

controles.affirmation: fondamental_externe #1 : "Ce risque figure en tete de la liste des facteurs susceptibles d'affecter les resultats futurs dans le 10-Q, preuve de sa materialite reconnue par la societe elle-meme"
controles.verbatim_source: Le passage n'est pas un facteur de risque (Item 1A) mais la premiere puce d'une enumeration non hierarchisee figurant sous "General Factors Affecting Results of Operations" : "We believe our future revenues and net income will continue to be influenced by a number of domestic and international economic trends, including: - trading volumes on our proprietary products such as VIX options and futures and SPX options, which are dependent on exclusive licenses that require renewals; - trading volumes in listed equity securities...". Le 10-Q n'indique nulle part que cette liste est classee par ordre d'importance.
controles.correction_proposee: Meme piege que le cas HIG : une position dans une liste est presentee comme un classement de materialite. Retirer "en tete de la liste" et "preuve de sa materialite reconnue par la societe elle-meme". Ecrire : "Cboe cite ce point parmi les tendances economiques susceptibles d'influencer ses revenus futurs, dans une liste non hierarchisee."

controles.affirmation: quantitatif #1 : "743,1 M$ de revenus sur le segment Options au T2 2026 (51% du CA total du groupe), en hausse de 29,1% sur un an ; North American Equities +17,7% ; CA total du groupe +23%"
controles.verbatim_source: "Options $743.1 | $575.8 | 29 % | 52 % | 49 %" ; "North American Equities 520.0 | 441.8 | 18 %" ; "Total revenues $1,442.8 | $1,173.5 | $269.3 | 23 %". Calculs exacts : 743,1/575,8 = +29,1% ; 520,0/441,8 = +17,7% ; 743,1/1 442,8 = 51,5%. A noter : le 10-Q imprime lui-meme 52% pour le poids du segment Options, l'ATT ecrit 51% (arrondi vers le bas, sans consequence sur le sens).

controles.affirmation: quantitatif #2 : "30,1 M$ de provision pour pertes de credit sur les billets a ordre lies au CAT, pour un solde net de 94,8 M$ au 30 juin 2026 ; environ un quart de l'encours brut"
controles.verbatim_source: Note 6 : "Allowance for notes receivable credit losses... Balance at December 31, 2025 $30.1 ... Balance at June 30, 2026 $30.1" ; note 7 : "Long-term notes receivable, net (1) 94.8 | 102.1" avec la note (1) "This balance primarily consists of the long-term notes receivable related to the CAT, net of allowance. Through the second quarter of 2026, the Company reclassified $7.3 million of long-term notes receivable to other current assets". Ratio : 30,1/(94,8+30,1) = 24,1%, soit bien environ un quart.

controles.affirmation: hook : "Le chiffre d'affaires de Cboe a bondi de 23% et son benefice net de 50% au T2 2026"
controles.verbatim_source: "Total revenues $1,442.8 | $1,173.5 | $269.3 | 23 %" ; "Net income allocated to common stockholders $351.8 | $233.9 | $117.9 | 50 %"
